assertions: An authorized Project Operator can complete exactly one ACCEPTED, EDITED, or REJECTED review through the public API.
EDITED stores only the separate editorial recommendation, pending-verification, and limitation fields.
The original model output, Finding identities, Evidence citations, and report Hash remain unchanged.
A second review and an edit outside the editorial contract fail closed.
The terminal review appends a redacted AuditEvent and triggers no Finding, GovernanceRun, scan, or external action.
